svg.title: The Best Deal — project card
svg.desc: A voiced story game about discounts: Amit buys a book, picks sneakers, then hunts the mall for the best deals for Rohan's party. Playable in six languages. Built with Javascript, I18N, Voice-Over. Live demo. Banner: the game's real title screen.
